summary: Frontend regression pass on /admin/overview (AUREM CTO preview) as requested. Logged in via test@aurem.dev, opened /admin/overview, verified full render of all ~24 sub-sections listed in the review request (dependency breaker strip, deploy-readiness banner, top-up alerts banner, LLM Provider Status, Boundary Probes, System Health chips+nav, Live metrics grid, System mapping, Cache & refresh, DB health, Backup/restore-drill, Mode classifier telemetry, Users & Ships, GitHub Connect Funnel strip, Features checklist, ORA council logs, User patterns, Activation funnel, DORA, SLO, Live Cost Alert, Journey Watch, Funnel nudge-stage). No crash, no error boundary fallback, only 1 unrelated console error (a 403 on a background resource — same one visible pre-fix, unrelated to this task). Both regression fixes confirmed live.

All new counts and provider names render without errors.

Consider splitting each card (GhFunnelStrip, SystemMappingCard, ActivationFunnelCard, DoraCard, SloCard, JourneyWatchCard, etc.) into its own file under frontend/src/pages/admin_overview/.
